My primary care doctor referred me here because I’m so preoccupied with how awful my face and neck look now that I’m starting to avoid the very community things that used to keep me going. It has just become really difficult for me to step out and face people lately.

turns.patient_response: It is entirely because of my appearance—I feel like my face and neck look so deformed and saggy from aging, and I dread others seeing me under bright lights or in photos. I don't have constant, generalized worries about other parts of my life. It's really just this overwhelming focus on how awful I look that is making me pull away.

I end up spending way too much time in the bathroom mirror before events adjusting my scarf and makeup, leaning in and out, and even taking selfies just to zoom in and inspect every wrinkle.
